title: Proton Drive Pricing: Plans, Renewal Costs (2026)
summary: Proton Drive pricing covers five tiers from free to $287.88 yearly for the Family plan. Compare exact costs, storage limits, and what each tier includes.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### Is Proton Drive free to use?


Yes, Proton Drive has a free tier, but its storage allowance is capped, and the cap is what pushes a growing team onto a paid plan.


Read Proton's pricing page, which lists the current free allowance and which features sit behind a subscription, against your real file volume before you build a workflow on the free account, because the first upgrade prompt tends to arrive when the data is already inside.


### Can I get a refund if I cancel my Proton Drive plan?


Possibly, but cancelling a plan and being refunded for it are separate things. Cancelling normally stops the next renewal and leaves the paid period running.


Whether money comes back depends on the refund terms Proton publishes for your billing cycle and payment method, and those terms can differ between monthly and longer commitments.


Find the refund language in Proton's terms and support pages before you pay for a long term, and cancel before the renewal date rather than after it.


### Does Proton Drive offer a lifetime plan?


Not as a standing option on the main pricing page. Proton has run limited-time lifetime offers in the past, but a promotion isn't a plan you can plan around.


If one is live when you read this, Proton's own site will show it. If it isn't, don't assume it will return.


For budgeting, treat the subscription and its renewal price as the real cost.


### Is Proton Drive cheaper than Google Drive for 1 TB?


It depends on which price you compare, and the headline figures rarely line up. Proton's advertised price often assumes a longer commitment, and the renewal price can differ from the first-term price.


Google's storage plans are sold through Google One, and the amount of storage is only one part of what that subscription includes.


Put both vendors' current renewal prices for the same term and the same seat count side by side, and use the prices on each vendor's own pricing page, not a third-party roundup.


### Do students or nonprofits get a Proton Drive discount?


Some groups do get a discount, but eligibility and terms are set on Proton's own pages, not in the standard checkout. Don't assume a discount applies because a plan is labeled for teams or organizations.


Apply through the route Proton specifies, keep the confirmation, and check whether the discounted rate holds at renewal. A discount that lapses after the first term is just another introductory price.
